name: youtube-agent
description: Thirty-three skills that run a YouTube channel: the original eleven plus Shorts-first, series and character bible, analytics, publish checklist, hub router, AI video prompt engineering, the algorithm-aware pro tier - algorithm model, trends, full packaging, sound, memes, and the viral-loop orchestrator - and the research-finalised tier: Studio diagnosis, originality and AI-disclosure gate, Shorts-to-long-form bridge, thumbnail testing, community routine, and YPP runway planner, and the 2026 signals update (viewed-vs-swiped-away, hook patterns, AI auto-labelling), and the v3.3.0 audit fixes (daily planning, install, CI, voice paths), and the v3.3.1 algorithm update (retrieval vs ranking, audience cluster, freshness, signal strength).
